description: OpenCode config keys managed by Riggverk install/health. User provider blocks, non-playwright MCP servers and agent entries other than the listed ones are preserved. agent_permissions: built-in agents whose agent.<name>.permission block is managed. subagent_model_roles: bundled subagents whose agent.<role>.model the app pins while a subagent or critic model override is set. It changes or removes such a model only when it can prove it wrote it: the value the override pins, or the one its managed record says the last install wrote, which goes when the override is cleared. Any other model of a role is the user's: kept on install, never drift or a conflict. Nothing else under agent.<role> is managed. tui_top_level: the top-level keys of tui.json the app manages; every other key of that file is the user's.
